interaction.kind: reference-mass balance construction, distinct from ruler and pouring
interaction.state: Strict casekey and exactdense array of allowed labelled masses100/500/1000g, boundednumber/sum; no unaccounted mass sources.
interaction.truth: sumG=sum(packs); referenceG=1000; equality exact. Classify under/equal/over by total mass only. Equal-arm beam tilt qualitative bysign, not a calibrated force or torque magnitude.
interaction.motion: If transition animated, one owned RAF/normalized progress drives all movingbeam/pan visuals. No falsely movingreference or unit-toggle mass change. Prefer short cancellable animation/no idle bounce. Check only settledstate or unambiguously currentcommitted model; no queue/timer leaks.
interaction.check: Correct iff valid complete mass equals target; under/over feedback in sameunit, no partial empty success. Multiple valid compositions accepted, no reportinglongsum requirement.
interaction.scope: Meaning ofg/kg and equal1kg reference. No thousand-counting gate, dense analogue-scale test, decimal kg, generic conversions, liftingstrength or personal bodymass.
